name: Jalali delivery date field
query: Add a delivery date field to checkout. Customers enter it in Shamsi (Jalali) and admins see it in Shamsi too.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Load references/jalali-dates.md and copy assets/class-persian.php
Step 2: Normalize digits with to_latin_digits() before parsing
Step 3: Convert Jalali input to Gregorian, validate with checkdate(), and store a timestamp in the site timezone
Step 5: Register the field with the Additional Checkout Fields API for the Checkout block
success_criteria: Stored value is Gregorian/UTC, not a Jalali string
Persian and Arabic digits are accepted
Dates around Nowruz and Esfand 30 are handled
